class: PERCEPTION_SUPPORT_CEILING_AUDIT (DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; fits NO new transfer model)
question: Is O2.4R's failure primarily (A) a within-support mapping-estimator limitation or (B) a limitation of the dense-perception support itself? I.e. what fraction of the target-native imagery-residual structure is geometrically accessible inside col(W_target)?

part2_full_support_ceiling.for: subject x ROI x outer fold x held-out identity
part2_full_support_ceiling.R_SUPPORT_FULL: ||P_SUPPORT delta_test||^2 / ||delta_test||^2, averaged over the 2 held-out identities per fold
part2_full_support_ceiling.meaning: max retention achievable by ANY subspace contained in col(W_target), regardless of estimator, provided the native prediction stays in col(W_target)

reconstruct: sealed O2.4R calibrated projectors where possible
part3_support_bound.require_pointwise: R_pred <= R_SUPPORT_FULL + 1e-10 for every subject x ROI x fold x M

part4_rank_matched_support_oracle.Z: 10 outer-training target residual coords, Z_i = W_target.T @ delta_target_i (outer-training identities only)
part4_rank_matched_support_oracle.svd: Z.T = U S V.T ; r = frozen r_best ; U_SUPPORT_ORACLE = U[:, :r] ; deterministic canonical column signs
part4_rank_matched_support_oracle.native: B_SUPPORT_ORACLE = W_target @ U_SUPPORT_ORACLE ; P_SUPPORT_ORACLE_R = B B.T

part6_aggregation.order: participant-first: average 6 outer folds -> R0_s, R_M10_s, R_SUPPORT_FULL_s, R_SUPPORT_ORACLE_R_s, R_NATIVE_ORACLE_s; THEN group medians

part11_classification.require_evaluable: >=7/8 participants for a primary mechanism classification (else INCONCLUSIVE)
part11_classification.B_RANK_MATCHED_SUPPORT_LIMIT_DOMINANT: median F_FULL >= 0.50 AND median F_RANK < 0.50 AND >=6/8 F_RANK < 0.50
part11_classification.C_WITHIN_SUPPORT_MAPPING_ESTIMATOR_DOMIN: median F_RANK >= 0.50 AND median F_EST < 0.50 AND >=6/8 F_EST < 0.50

interpretation_guard.allowed_if_full_support_low: Under the prospectively re-derived dense-perception representation, a substantial portion of the target-native imagery-residual structure lies outside the native subspace accessible through the tested perception-derived W_target.
interpretation_guard.scope: statement about the TESTED REPRESENTATIONAL MODEL only
